title: Lag Alert
description: Alerts players about server lag due to CPU, RAM, disk usage or TPS.
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dfffe4ab509d68e3fc6d4b36397fea363e163133.png)

![desc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50e7325f57bdaaf405637cd38ac15a6e78835221.png)
----
- Tracks usage of server **RAM, CPU and disk** dynamically. When the CPU usage is high for sometime, automatically warns players, same with RAM. 
- Scans disk, CPU and RAM very efficiently, **no performance downgrade** at all.
- Can warn players and also log them in console.
- Tracks **TPS and MSPT** and warns players about it if certain limit is crossed. (Configurable)

No configuration needed, just install, and use PlugManX or normal server restart to load the plugin. 
**Everything is configurable.**
## Default Config

- RAM source: `container`
- RAM options: `container`, `auto`, `physical`, `heap`
- Disk source: `auto`
- Disk options: `auto`, `server-files`, `filesystem`
